title: Covered Component Groups: The Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage Matrix
content:
# Coverage Matrix of Component Groups

Every coverage type of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage carries one switch per component group. A switch set to Yes means the coverage covers that component group; No means it does not.

## Component groups

| Component group | What the switch covers |
|---|---|
| Engine | engine internal parts |
| Transmission | transmission and transaxle |
| Drive axle | front and rear drive systems |
| Electrical | electrical components and modules |
| Air conditioning | the air conditioning system |
| Suspension | suspension components |
| Brakes | brake system components other than pads and rotors |
| Infotainment | audio, navigation and connectivity units |
| Emission components | emission control components (catalytic converter, engine control module, onboard diagnostic device) |
| Hybrid battery | hybrid or electric drive battery |
| Scheduled maintenance | factory-scheduled maintenance services |
| Safety recall defect | the remedy of a safety recall campaign |

## Matrix by coverage type

Abbreviations for the columns: UV Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty; CM Factory Complimentary Maintenance; BL Factory Basic Limited Warranty; PT Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty; CPO Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty; EM Federal Emissions Performance Warranty; SR Safety Recall Remedy Coverage.

| Component group | UV | CM | BL | PT | CPO | EM | SR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engine | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Transmission | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Drive axle | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Electrical | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Air conditioning | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Suspension | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Brakes | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Infotainment | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Emission components | No | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Hybrid battery | No | No | No | No | No | Yes | No |
| Scheduled maintenance | No | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |
| Safety recall defect | No | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |

## The same matrix read by coverage type

- **Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty:** engine and transmission only.
- **Factory Complimentary Maintenance:** scheduled maintenance only.
- **Factory Basic Limited Warranty:** engine, transmission, drive axle, electrical, air conditioning, suspension, brakes, infotainment and emission components; not the hybrid battery, scheduled maintenance or a safety recall defect.
- **Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty** and **Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty:** engine, transmission and drive axle.
- **Federal Emissions Performance Warranty:** emission components and the hybrid battery.
- **Safety Recall Remedy Coverage:** the safety recall defect only.

**Hypothetical lookup.** A failed hybrid drive battery has a Yes only under the Federal Emissions Performance Warranty column; a failed audio unit has a Yes only under the Factory Basic Limited Warranty column.
